title: Celeste Legaspi recalls Lea Salonga’s early theater days before Walk of Fame star

blocks.text: Before Lea Salonga made history by becoming the first Filipino to receive a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, veteran singer-actress Celeste Legaspi had the chance to witness the former’s early years in music and theater. Legaspi shared a photo of herself with Salonga on Instagram on Sunday, Sept. 21, revealing that international theater star watched the closing night of “The Notebook: The Musical” in Circuit Makati. “Lea Salonga watched The Notebook last night and graciously said hi to the whole cast,” Legaspi wrote.
